scientific_question: In a separate migratory *Grus grus* source, can repeated days with flight-state, terrain-relative altitude and independently annotated atmosphere distinguish stable individual vertical-use strategies from a shared weather/flight-mode response?

independent_source.title: Cranes soar on thermal updrafts behind cold fronts as they migrate across the sea
independent_source.source_paper: Pekarsky et al. 2024 Proc. Royal Society B, 10.1098/rspb.2023.1243
independent_source.note: 44 birds are source-publication coverage, not a claim that all have complete independently usable raw GPS/altitude data. File table API lists 37 objects, including multiple individual raw GPS+ACC CSV files and summary files.
independent_source.strict_reuse: Source includes behavior/sea-thermal studies; new endpoint is within-bird day-heldout vertical probability response, not reanalysis of published sea-soaring incidence, thermal climb or airspeed.

nonduplication.Scacco_species: Grus nigricollis present, Grus grus NOT represented among 38 observed taxa in the source catalog
nonduplication.conclusion: Candidate is taxonomically different from the previous Gyps, gull, bat and Ciconia height studies and a different Dryad parent, but independent device/study source still must be checked from raw IDs.
nonduplication.taxonomic_independence_not_biological_ef: Being a new species/study does not ensure observations support both wind/flight states or repeated spatial matching.

source_access_gate.first: Official public Dryad v4 API manifest; verify n=37 files, SHA256 values and metadata rights WITHOUT downloading raw GPS height values.
source_access_gate.second: Attempt official file download API GET for README and one 2.7MB GPS bird sample, no web proxy or login bypass. Respect HTTP 401/403 by saving ACCESS_UNAVAILABLE receipt and stopping; do not pretend parsed 2.1GB data.
source_access_gate.on_success: Validate downloaded byte SHA256 for both pilot files, then inspect source CSV header plus ONLY timestamp, bird ID, longitude/latitude, flight state and atmospheric nonvertical values. Do not parse numeric Altitude_m, AleAboveTerrain or TerrainHeight.
source_access_gate.after_success: Only if pilot source columns match, open source pilot distinct tracking days, 1Hz cadence, wind/flight availability. Then extend to multiple bird files for source x-y gate; no altitude effect until enough distinct birds.
source_access_gate.source_approval: CC0 is publicly dedicated, but API 401/403 is an access boundary, not justification for guessing/unverified download URLs.

future_preheight_thresholds.target_year_selection: No outcome-guided year choice: pilot source file IDs fixed; for full cohort include all published per-bird files and calendar years, stratify by year as source factor.
future_preheight_thresholds.behavioral_states: Use externally annotated `running_Flap_rate` as a continuous predictor or preregistered source-defined soaring/gliding classifications; do not fabricate binary state thresholds from results.
future_preheight_thresholds.atmosphere: Test weather against source independently annotated `blh`, `sstDiff`, `msshf` and 850/925 hPa wind; these are atmospheric proxies, not direct uplift at GPS bird location.
future_preheight_thresholds.vertical_next_stage: Use source `AleAboveTerrain` (AGL proxy) with native terrain/depth metadata audit; source `Altitude_m` is raw measured altitude with potentially tag noise; never choose height source after outcomes.
future_preheight_thresholds.minimum_3_flight_and_weather_repeat_days: Needs at least 2 days in both low/high independently-defined atmosphere conditions in each bird to evaluate shared vs bird-specific reaction.
future_preheight_thresholds.forbid_5km_to_50km_rescue: If 5km primary fails, the 50km migratory grain is a predeclared separate ecological scale with separate estimand and claims. Do not reinterpret 50km as 5km.

biological_null_model_future.shared_weather: P(z_AGL centered | source study/year, flight-state, month, geographic cell, atmospheric conditions) with focal bird excluded
biological_null_model_future.bird_specific: P(z_AGL centered | same context, bird-specific atmospheric slope/reaction) using only source days other than heldout date.
biological_null_model_future.test: Incremental heldout bird-day log score over shared reaction baseline with bird-clustered uncertainty and 999 matched whole-bird-day weather permutations preserving date/weather shared correlation.
biological_null_model_future.confirmatory_gate: Freeze full source/bird roster and estimator before any numeric GPS altitude opening; allocate at least 10 individually repeated birds and a source-level 950/999 valid-null floor
biological_null_model_future.interpretation: An unsupported difference cannot prove reaction equivalence. Positive means better prediction conditional on model and source, not direct causal winds/adaptation.
